title: Executive at IT Services Provider Expects Teradata-Related Business to Grow 8% in 2026 and 10% in 2027
expert: Head of cloud and software practice at a large Europe/UK IT services provider (current; $15–20M Teradata-related revenue, 20–25 enterprise customers)
verdict: A $15–20 million Teradata practice grew about 8% y/y in Q4 2026 but finished about 6% below plan on deal slippage and competitive evaluations, with cloud +13% offset by on-prem subscription -4% and maintenance -15%.

Cloud ARR: 🟢 Cloud spend about 13% y/y in Q4 2026, 15%–18% expected for 2027 (estimate); in line with the 2026-11-09 call's footprint +12%–15% y/y. [15 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269610&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse18385&hl=fse18385,fse19064,fse19132&page=2)

🟡 On-prem subscription about -4%, maintenance -15% y/y; milder on subscription than the 2026-11-09 call's on-prem -5%–8%. [15 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269610&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse18385&hl=fse18385,fse19064,fse19132&page=2)
Pricing & renewals: 🔴 Maintenance list +7% but effective only about 2% after discounts; pricing pressure 8/10 with 50%–60% of renewals carrying Snowflake/Databricks quotes; first read on Teradata pricing. [3 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269610&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse32894&hl=fse32894,fse32961,fse33014&page=2)

🟢 Renewal spend about 5% higher y/y, 1/3 of customers expanding scope; different measure from the 2026-11-09 call's Q4 renewal dollars ~10% below Q3. [11 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269610&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse22277&hl=fse22277,fse22884,fse23026&page=2)
Competition & share: 🔴 New-logo pipeline 10%–15% vs 15%–20% a year ago; 75%–80% of customers weighing alternatives move new workloads to Snowflake/Databricks while keeping the core; consistent with the 2026-11-09 call (net new 10% of pipeline). [9 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269610&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse27999&hl=fse27999,fse28108&page=2)

changes: Cloud: cloud spend +13% y/y (expert) vs the 2026-11-09 call's software footprint +12%–15% y/y: consistent.
On-prem: subscription -4% and maintenance -15% y/y (expert) vs the 2026-11-09 call's on-prem spend -5%–8% y/y: similar direction, maintenance decline steeper.
Deal size: new implementations up ~10% y/y vs the 2026-11-09 call's average deal size +12%–15%: slightly slower.
Competition: new-logo pipeline share 10%–15% (from 15%–20%) vs the 2026-11-09 call's net-new 10% of pipeline: consistent, new logos scarce.
thesis_impact: No tenets on the TDC page; against its pitch (cloud ARR growth, total ARR 8–12%, 75%+ FCF to buybacks): Cloud ARR ↑ — cloud +13% now, 15%–18% expected in 2027; total ARR → — practice +8% y/y but 6% below plan, on-prem -4% and maintenance -15%; pricing ↓ — effective maintenance uplift ~2% vs 7% list under 8/10 pressure, a margin headwind for FCF.

new_datapoints.text: EU/UK IT services practice ($15–20M Teradata revenue) grew about 8% y/y in Q4 2026, about 6% below plan
Teradata cloud spend about +13%, on-prem subscription about -4%, maintenance -15% y/y in Q4 2026 (expert's book)
Teradata maintenance list price up about 7%, effective about 2% after discounts; cloud subscription quoted up about 4%, on-prem subscription up 5%
Teradata pricing pressure 8/10; 50%–60% of renewals involve Snowflake/Databricks competitive quotes
Teradata new implementation deals around $1.5 million (up about 10%); renewals about $1 million (up about 4%)
Teradata sales cycles 10%–15% longer; complex migrations nine to 18 months
New-logo share of Teradata pipeline 10%–15% in 2026 vs 15%–20% a year ago
Teradata renewal spend about 5% higher y/y; 1/3 of customers expanding scope
Customers planning to evaluate Teradata Tera 30%–35% vs 15%–20% in August; Tera production 2%–3%; AI Studio 6% or 7% active
Expert expects 2027 Teradata-related growth about 10%, cloud 15%–18%, on-prem -7%
